deep_dive.title: Bayesian Flow Networks for Offline Trajectory Planning
deep_dive.abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) leverages static datasets to learn decision policies without real-time environment interaction. While recent sequence-modeling approaches rely on continuous diffusion models for trajectory synthesis, applying these methods to discrete planning tasks requires a categorical formulation rather than the standard Gaussian construction. We present BFN-RL, a unified generative modeling framework for offline RL based on Bayesian Flow Networks (BFNs). By iteratively evolving distribution parameters rather than noisy data instances, BFN-RL natively models both discrete and continuous trajectory spaces within a single probabilistic formulation. The categorical planner generates future state sequences, and a learned inverse-dynamics model converts consecutive generated states into actions. Evaluations in discrete planning and continuous control show that BFN-RL can generate effective trajectories across both categorical and continuous state spaces. Our results establish BFNs as a versatile generative foundation for offline trajectory planning across data modalities.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes BFN-RL, a Bayesian Flow Network based generative framework for offline RL that models discrete and continuous trajectories by iteratively evolving distribution parameters, with a categorical planner and inverse-dynamics model.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 离线强化学习中的轨迹合成常依赖连续扩散模型，难以直接处理离散规划任务。本文提出BFN-RL，一个基于贝叶斯流网络的统一生成框架，通过迭代演化分布参数而非带噪数据实例，在单一概率公式中建模离散与连续轨迹空间。分类规划器生成未来状态序列，结合学到的逆动力学模型转换为动作。结果表明该方法能有效完成离线轨迹规划，展示了贝叶斯深度生成模型在序列决策中的应用前景。
